{"code": "import requests, json, re, datetime, sys, bs4, pandas as pd\\n\\ndef get_wayback_snapshot(url, date):\\n    # date format YYYYMMDD\\n    ts = date + '000000'\\n    api = f'http://archive.org/wayback/available?url={url}&timestamp={ts}'\\n    r = requests.get(api, timeout=10)\\n    data = r.json()\\n    if data.get('archived_snapshots') and data['archived_snapshots'].get('closest'):\\n        return data['archived_snapshots']['closest']['url']\\n    return None\\n\\n# try base domain and menu page\\nbase = 'https://virtuerec.com'\\nmenu = 'https://virtuerec.com/menu'\\nfor d in ['20210322','20210421']:\\n    snap = get_wayback_snapshot(base, d)\\n    snap_menu = get_wayback_snapshot(menu, d)\\n    print(d, snap, snap_menu)\\n"}

{"code": "import requests, json, datetime, pandas as pd, sys, re, itertools, math, time\\n\\ndef list_snapshots(url, start_year, end_year):\\n    # CDX API\\n    api = f'http://web.archive.org/cdx/search/cdx?url={url}&output=json&from={start_year}&to={end_year}&fl=timestamp,original,statuscode,mimetype&filter=statuscode:200&collapse=digest'\\n    r = requests.get(api, timeout=20)\\n    data = r.json()\\n    # first row is fields\\n    fields = data[0]\\n    rows = data[1:]\\n    df = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=fields)\\n    return df\\n\\nbase='virtuerec.com'\\ndf = list_snapshots(base, 2021, 2021)\\nprint(df.head())\\nprint('total', len(df))\\n"}

{"code": "import requests, bs4, re, json, urllib.parse, time\\n\\ndef google_search(query):\\n    # Use DuckDuckGo API again but maybe include site:virtuerec.com\\n    url='https://duckduckgo.com/html/'\\n    headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}\\n    data={'q':query}\\n    r=requests.post(url, data=data, headers=headers, timeout=15)\\n    soup=bs4.BeautifulSoup(r.text,'html.parser')\\n    links=[]\\n    for a in soup.select('a.result__a'):\\n        href=a['href']\\n        parsed=urllib.parse.urlparse(href)\\n        qs=urllib.parse.parse_qs(parsed.query)\\n        if 'uddg' in qs:\\n            real=urllib.parse.unquote(qs['uddg'][0])\\n        else:\\n            real=href\\n        links.append(real)\\n    return links[:20]\\n\\nqueries=['Virtue Chicago restaurant', 'Virtue restaurant Chicago', 'Virtue Chicago menu', 'Virtue Chicago dinner menu']\\nfor q in queries:\\n    try:\\n        res=google_search(q)\\n        print('Query:',q)\\n        for r in res:\\n            print(' ',r)\\n    except Exception as e:\\n        print('Error',q,e)\\n"}
